data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'fahahi', meaning 'intelligent, wise, successful'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies wisdom and success in all areas of life. The name Fawzi carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise, Successful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawzi usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, successful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek wisdom and knowledge in their spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Fawzi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise, Successful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawzi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
